name: tpl-precedence-1-nogoal
task: If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task is a conditional rule ('If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first'), so hard Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) is the exact template: the exit may not happen before the switch is toggled. It adds no Existence for the exit or the switch, since the task commands neither, and the rule-only warning is valid. Without a siren there is no switch, so this rule then forbids the exit. The task's own wording causes that, so it is not a clause defect.

texts: Reaching the exit requires that the switch was already toggled on an earlier step: the exit may not happen before the switch has been toggled.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:

FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u2

(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
